Name: AtraCore
Author: Atravita
TagLine: A centralized location for some of my utility functions.
Description:
A centralized location for some helper utilities my other mods use.

Install

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
Uninstall
Simply remove this mod from your Mods folder.

Compatibility

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows. **Does not work on Android.**

*   Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. In multiplayer, all players should install.

*   Should be compatible with most other mods.
See also

*   [Changelog](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/AtraCore/docs/changelog.md)

*   [Source](https://github.com/atravita-mods/StardewMods/blob/main/AtraCore)

All donation points for this mod go to [Against Malaria](https://www.againstmalaria.com/). Please consider supporting them if you like this mod!
Looking for something else? Please consider [my other mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/116553368?tab=user+files)!
